name: Historical Motorsport Incident Reconstruction Benchmark (MII-HIRB-v1.1)
description: Expanded multi-circuit, multi-season benchmark evaluating multi-modal evidence reconstruction quality across verified real-world Formula 1 incidents and nominal racing controls without predicting driver fault, guilt, or sporting penalties.

epistemic_framework.core_principle: EVIDENCE RECONSTRUCTION QUALITY ONLY - NO FAULT OR PENALTY PREDICTION
epistemic_framework.steward_decisions_role: DOCUMENTARY context only, never physical ground truth or training labels for guilt
epistemic_framework.double_counting_prevention: Root observation lineage tracking via LineageTracker

provenance_standards.OFFICIAL_DOCUMENT: FIA Stewards Decisions, Race Control messages, official classifications
provenance_standards.DERIVED_FROM_SAME_TELEMETRY: Shared ECU/CAN-bus telemetry channel (classified as consistency check, not independent measurement)
provenance_standards.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Data stream is unavailable under copyright or licensing without synthetic fabrication
